inputs.text:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic frame from a historical epic film, continuing seamlessly from the previous gladiator shots.

SCENE:
Inside a massive ancient Roman amphitheater during a brutal gladiatorial duel. Two muscular adult gladiators are engaged in close combat in the center of the sandy arena. The camera is positioned close to the fighters at a dramatic low three-quarter angle, capturing the intensity of the impact.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:
The primary gladiator from the previous shots remains exactly the same: extremely muscular adult male, deeply tanned skin, short dark hair, black horsehair crest on an aged bronze Roman helmet, worn bronze shoulder armor, dark leather segmented skirt, leather bracers, heavy greaves, large weathered round shield decorated with an aged Roman eagle and laurel motif.

The opposing gladiator remains visually consistent with the previous shots: muscular adult male, dark bronze helmet with black crest, battered bronze armor, dark red and brown leather skirt, large round shield, battle-worn equipment and realistic skin texture.

ACTION:
The attacking gladiator lunges forward aggressively with his gladius extended toward the opposing fighter. The defending gladiator reacts instantly, raising his large round shield to block the incoming sword strike.

The sword makes forceful contact with the shield, producing a small burst of sparks and fragments of dust. Both fighters show realistic physical tension: tightened muscles, strained posture, aggressive movement, defensive positioning and believable weight distribution.

The moment should feel like a single frozen frame from a high-budget historical action movie.

ENVIRONMENT:
A colossal ancient Roman amphitheater surrounds the fighters. Thousands of spectators fill the stone seating in the background. Large deep-red Roman banners decorated with gold laurel symbols hang between massive stone columns. Tall statues stand above the arena walls. Large bronze fire braziers burn on the upper levels.

The arena floor is covered with dry golden sand, footprints, disturbed dirt and airborne dust from the combat.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Photorealistic theatrical movie cinematography.
Large-format cinema camera.
35mm cinematic lens.
Low camera position approximately waist height.
Strong foreground-to-background depth separation.
Natural perspective.
Shallow depth of field while keeping both fighters recognizable.
The foreground gladiator occupies approximately the left side of the frame while the attacking gladiator dominates the right-center.
The Roman amphitheater and crowd remain clearly recognizable in the background.

LIGHTING:
Warm late-afternoon sunlight entering the arena.
Natural golden sunlight illuminating the fighters from the upper left.
Realistic highlights across bronze armor and skin.
Soft atmospheric haze.
Volumetric sunlight passing through suspended dust particles.
Physically realistic shadows and reflections.
No artificial neon lighting.

REALISM:
Extremely realistic human anatomy.
Realistic muscles, skin pores, sweat, scars, scratches and dirt.
Physically accurate Roman armor construction.
Realistic metal surfaces with scratches, dents and oxidation.
Realistic leather texture.
Realistic cloth and banner movement.
Realistic sand particles and dust.
Natural facial proportions.
Natural hands and fingers.
No plastic-looking skin.
No fantasy armor.
No exaggerated superhero anatomy.

ACTION DETAIL:
Sword striking shield.
Tiny metallic sparks at the point of impact.
Sand exploding around the fighters' feet.
Fine dust particles suspended in the sunlight.
Subtle motion blur on the sword and attacking arm.
Sharp focus on the helmets, shields and point of impact.
Crowd reacting energetically in the background.

COMPOSITION:
Vertical 9:16 cinematic composition.
Full-body or three-quarter-body framing.
Strong visual depth.
Foreground fighter partially closer to camera.
Second fighter clearly visible and separated from the background.
The image must communicate "two gladiators locked in a decisive battle" instantly.

VISUAL STYLE:
Ultra-photorealistic.
High-budget historical epic.
Premium theatrical movie still.
Physically based rendering.
Natural cinematic color science.
High dynamic range.
Detailed textures.
Subtle film grain.
Realistic atmospheric perspective.
Sharp micro-detail.
No illustration.
No painting.
No cartoon.
No video-game appearance.
No artificial CGI look.

CONTINUITY:
This image must look like the immediate next shot in the same movie sequence as the previous gladiator images. Preserve the same characters, armor designs, helmet shapes, weapons, shields, colors, arena architecture, banners, lighting direction and time of day.

NO TEXT.
NO LOGOS.
NO WATERMARK.
NO MODERN OBJECTS.
NO EXTRA LIMBS.
NO DEFORMED HANDS.
NO DUPLICATE CHARACTERS.
NO DISTORTED FACES.
